stories.title: De lagarto a medicamento: a ciência por trás das canetas emagrecedoras e como o tema pode cair no vestibular

en.title: From lizard to medication: the science behind weight-loss pens and how the topic could appear on college entrance exams
en.summary: Weight-loss pens are emerging as a potential college entrance exam topic due to associated benefits, risks, and debates over irregular use and illegal sales. Students should understand three key concepts: human physiology, public health, and environmental protection.

stories.title: Resultado das eleições 2026 em Nova Mamoré (RO): como foi a votação no 1º turno

en.title: Results of the 2026 elections in Nova Mamoré (RO): how voting went in the first round
en.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro received 11,731 votes in Nova Mamoré, while Lula received 2,781 votes in first-round presidential voting. The results were announced by Brazil's Superior Electoral Court.

stories.title: Resultado das eleições 2026 em Castanheiras (RO): como foi a votação no 1º turno

en.title: Results of the 2026 elections in Castanheiras (RO): how voting went in the first round
en.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro received 1,616 votes in Castanheiras, while Lula received 879 votes in first-round presidential voting. The results were disclosed by Brazil's Superior Electoral Court.

stories.title: Resultado das eleições 2026 em Touros (RN): votação para presidente na Escola Municipal de Perobas, na 14ª zona eleitoral

en.title: Results of the 2026 elections in Touros (RN): presidential voting at Municipal School of Perobas, in the 14th electoral zone
en.summary: Lula received 13,200 votes in Touros, while Flavio Bolsonaro received 8,127 votes in first-round presidential voting. Brazil's Superior Electoral Court released the results.

stories.title: Nobel de Física 2026 premia detecção de neutrinos de alta energia

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics awarded for detection of high-energy neutrinos
en.summary: Francis Halzen received the Nobel Prize in Physics for his contributions to detecting high-energy neutrinos using the IceCube observatory at the South Pole. The award was given to a single scientist, which is relatively rare.

stories.title: ‘Futuro brasileiro é de hegemonia conservadora’, diz Pavanato, deputado federal mais votado em SP

en.title: Brazil's future is one of conservative hegemony, says Pavanato, most voted federal deputy in São Paulo
en.summary: Pavanato, the most voted federal deputy in São Paulo, states that Brazil's future will be characterized by conservative hegemony.

stories.title: Televangelista americano Jim Bakker, envolvido em escândalos de fraude e sexo, morre aos 86 anos

en.title: American televangelist Jim Bakker, involved in fraud and sex scandals, dies at 86
en.summary: Jim Bakker, an American televangelist who built a multimillion-dollar empire before facing scandal due to sexual misconduct, fraud conviction, and divorce from television presenter Tammy Faye, died at age 86.

stories.title: Podcast explica como bolsonarismo se organizou para obter domínio no 1º turno

en.title: Podcast explains how Bolsonarism organized to gain dominance in the first round
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro and allies met to discuss second-round campaign strategies, while Lula seeks to strengthen messaging about potential perpetuation of Bolsonaro family power to attract center voters.

stories.title: Morre Jim Bakker, evangelista envolvido em escândalo sexual e crimes financeiros, aos 86 anos

en.title: Jim Bakker, evangelist involved in sexual scandal and financial crimes, dies at 86
en.summary: Jim Bakker, an evangelical preacher who faced sexual and financial crime allegations, has died at age 86.

stories.title: Saiba como estão as disputas nos Estados com segundo turno para o governo

en.title: Learn how the disputes in states with runoff elections for governor stand
en.summary: Seven Brazilian states and the Federal District are holding second-round elections to determine their next governors.

stories.title: Filho de Arthur Lira se torna o mais jovem deputado federal já eleito

en.title: Son of Arthur Lira becomes the youngest federal deputy ever elected
en.summary: Alvinho Lira, a 20-year-old from Alagoas and son of former Chamber president Arthur Lira, was elected as Brazil's youngest-ever federal deputy in 2026.

stories.title: Nobel de Física 2026 vai para uso de cúbico de gelo para captar neutrinos

en.title: 2026 Physics Nobel Prize goes to use of ice cube to detect neutrinos
en.summary: Belgian-American physicist Francis Halzen received the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and discovery of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos.

stories.title: Disparada dos ativos expõe fratura na relação entre governo Lula e mercado

en.title: Asset surge exposes rift in relationship between Lula government and market
en.summary: A decline in long-term interest rates and dollar appreciation following the first round of elections signal eroded confidence between the financial market and the PT government, with price adjustments awaiting a viable alternative to current economic policy.

stories.title: Kassab vê PSD encolher no Congresso e perder Estados após aposta em Caiado

en.title: Kassab sees PSD shrink in Congress and lose States after Caiado bet
en.summary: The PSD, led by Gilberto Kassab, lost seats in both chambers of Congress, ceded control of major States, and finished fifth in the presidential race with Ronaldo Caiado, breaking the party's historical pattern of winning alliances.

stories.title: Dia das Crianças deve movimentar R$ 20,2 bi em compras, aponta Abecs

en.title: Children's Day expected to generate R$ 20.2 billion in purchases, points out Abecs
en.summary: Seventy percent of Brazilians intend to purchase gifts for the upcoming Children's Day, driving spending of R$ 20.2 billion, a 7.5% increase compared to the previous year, with toys leading gift preferences.

stories.title: Controladora da Nyse lança contratos futuros de ouro em Londres

en.title: NYSE parent launches gold futures contracts in London
en.summary: Intercontinental Exchange, owner of the New York Stock Exchange, launched a new gold futures contract in London to establish a derivatives market in the world's leading physical gold trading center.

stories.title: Desconto do Santander parece questionável após eleição no Brasil, avalia Citi

en.title: Santander's Discount Appears Questionable After Brazil Election, Citi Assesses
en.summary: Citi analysts question why Santander trades at a discount to peer banks, noting that first-round election results in Brazil may have reassured investors about economic stability.
